w2-outer-relation.where: (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "adversarial_categories" "cerbos_adversarial_categories_1" WHERE "cerbos_adversarial_categories_1"."resource_id" = "adversarial_resources"."id" AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "adversarial_sub_categories" "cerbos_adversarial_sub_categories_2" WHERE "cerbos_adversarial_sub_categories_2"."category_id" = "cerbos_adversarial_categories_1"."id") = 1 AND (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "adversarial_tags" "cerbos_adversarial_tags_3" WHERE "cerbos_adversarial_tags_3"."resource_id" = "adversarial_resources"."id" AND "cerbos_adversarial_tags_3"."name" = 'public') THEN TRUE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "adversarial_tags" "cerbos_adversarial_tags_3" WHERE "cerbos_adversarial_tags_3"."resource_id" = "adversarial_resources"."id" AND ("cerbos_adversarial_tags_3"."name" = 'public') IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE FALSE END))) THEN TRUE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "adversarial_categories" "cerbos_adversarial_categories_1" WHERE "cerbos_adversarial_categories_1"."resource_id" = "adversarial_resources"."id" AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "adversarial_sub_categories" "cerbos_adversarial_sub_categories_2" WHERE "cerbos_adversarial_sub_categories_2"."category_id" = "cerbos_adversarial_categories_1"."id") = 1 AND (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "adversarial_tags" "cerbos_adversarial_tags_3" WHERE "cerbos_adversarial_tags_3"."resource_id" = "adversarial_resources"."id" AND "cerbos_adversarial_tags_3"."name" = 'public') THEN TRUE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "adversarial_tags" "cerbos_adversarial_tags_3" WHERE "cerbos_adversarial_tags_3"."resource_id" = "adversarial_resources"."id" AND ("cerbos_adversarial_tags_3"."name" = 'public') IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE FALSE END)) IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE FALSE END)
